posts.title: null and a Missing Key Are Different States - Why a PATCH Erases Values
posts.description: null and a missing key are different JSON states, yet get-style reads merge them and a PATCH erases values. RFC 7396 and live runs show the safe patterns.

posts.title: Making ^ and $ Apply to Each Line - What the Multiline Flag Actually Changes and Where $ Misses on CRLF
posts.description: The multiline flag only makes ^ and $ recognize line boundaries. Python, Node, .NET, Perl and grep output on LF and CRLF input shows how $, \A and \z differ.

posts.title: Where tar Strips the Leading Slash - How Files Packed With Absolute Paths End Up in the Wrong Place
posts.description: tar strips the leading slash from absolute paths, so extraction nests the whole parent path. GNU tar 1.35 output on -C, -P, .. entries and top-level layout.

posts.title: A Slow First Run Is Not a Code Problem - Cutting the Warm-Up Window and Judging Convergence
posts.description: One-variable runs show why the first call is slow, and a moving median picks how many runs to discard. Output: Python 3.13.3 and Node v22.16.0 on this PC.

posts.title: A List Declared on a Class Belongs to No Instance - Attribute Lookup, Inheritance and ClassVar Decide How Far It Is Shared
posts.description: An attribute missing from the instance dict is looked up on the class and parents. Python 3.13 runs show the += trap, inheritance and dataclass ClassVar.

posts.title: The Dialects of Replacement Strings - Where $1, \1 and & Are Read Differently in sed, awk, perl, Python, JS and PowerShell
posts.description: Replacement strings differ by tool. Output from sed, awk, perl, Python, JS and PowerShell 5.1 shows how & and $1 are read and how to insert literals.

posts.title: Sorted and 10 Comes Before 9 - Why the Default Comparator Compares Strings
posts.description: Without a comparator, sort() converts elements to strings and compares UTF-16 code units. Node.js 22 output covers undefined, wrong comparators and stability.

posts.title: One Local Time Occurs Twice and Another Never Occurs - The Holes in Local Clock Time
posts.description: On daylight saving change days a local time may not exist or may occur twice. Python, Node.js and PowerShell output shows how each converts it to UTC.

posts.title: The Copy Changed the Original - Where a Shallow Copy Stops and What copy.deepcopy Covers
posts.description: Assignment, slicing, copy() and copy.copy rebuild only the outer layer. Python 3.13 runs cover nested data, tuples, dataclasses, and deepcopy memo and cost.

posts.title: What Happens When open() Has No encoding Argument - Why the Same Code Breaks Only on Windows
posts.description: Without an encoding argument, open() uses the locale encoding. Python 3.13 runs on Windows cover UnicodeDecodeError, UTF-8 mode, EncodingWarning and 3.15.
